subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 7: Switch On – Learning is fun (video and project)
outcomes: Understand that people can learn new things at any age.
Use verb–noun collocations: repair a car, take a class, make friends.
Make an information sheet about evening classes with my group.

tf.s: The video says you can learn new things at any age and anywhere.
tf.why: That is the main message of the video.

tf.s: According to the video, learning stops when you leave school.
tf.why: The video shows people learning throughout their lives.

tf.s: Some people learn new things from home with apps or video tutorials.
tf.why: The video mentions learning from home.

tf.s: Learning new skills can help you feel more confident.
tf.why: The video says new skills make people more confident.

tf.s: We say 'make a class' when we start a course.
tf.why: We say 'take a class' or 'join a class'.

tf.s: Evening classes can help you meet new people.
tf.why: The video says learners meet new people.

tf.s: An information sheet about classes doesn't need times.
tf.why: Each class needs its time, length, materials and content.

tf.s: We say 'repair a car' when we fix it.
A photo on an information sheet makes it harder to understand.
tf.why: Photos show quickly what the class is about.

tf.s: We say 'She made new friends there.'

boxes.q: Complete: My dad wants to ___ our car himself.
Complete: She ___ new friends at the class.
Complete: I want to ___ a cooking class.
When can people learn, according to the video?

boxes.why: Lifelong means for your whole life.

boxes.q: Which information should each class on the sheet include?
boxes.why: People need to know when, how long and what to bring.

boxes.q: Complete: The cooking class ___ at 6 p.m. every Monday.
boxes.why: He/she/it in the present simple adds -s.

boxes.q: Which is a good sentence for an information sheet?
o: Please bring an apron and a notebook.
boxes.why: It tells people clearly what to bring.

boxes.q: Complete: The class ___ her the confidence to apply for a promotion.

hunt.q: Things you bring to a class

mcq.q: What is the main message of the video?
o: You can learn things at any age and anywhere
You need a lot of money to learn
mcq.why: The video is about learning throughout your life.

mcq.q: How do some people learn new things from home?
o: They use apps or watch video tutorials
They visit a museum every day
mcq.why: The video mentions apps and video tutorials.
We join or take a class.

mcq.q: What must each class description on the sheet include?
o: time, length, what to bring and what people will learn
mcq.why: These details help people choose a class.

mcq.q: Complete: She ___ new friends there, and that ___ her the confidence to apply for a promotion.
Which question could you ask another group about their sheet?
o: How long is the pottery class?
mcq.why: It asks for information on the sheet.

mcq.q: Your uncle wants to fix his own bike. Which evening class is best for him?
mcq.why: A repair class teaches you to fix things.

mcq.q: How are evening classes different from school?
o: People choose them and can join at any age
They are always free and every day
mcq.why: Adults choose evening classes to learn new skills.

mcq.q: Why is a photo or drawing useful on an information sheet?
o: It shows quickly what the class is about
mcq.why: Pictures make the sheet clear and attractive.

mcq.q: Which is an advantage of learning new skills mentioned in the video?
o: You feel more confident and meet new people
mcq.why: New skills help confidence and friendships.
